# ALM Nexus — Technical Capabilities & Agency Reference

> Canonical Domain: https://almnexus.tech
> Agency Positioning: AI, Web & Mobile Software Engineering Agency
> Founder & Lead Architect: Abdul Ahad Rana
> Service Regions: US, UK, UAE, EU, Worldwide (Remote Delivery from Pakistan)
> Primary Contact: contact@almnexus.tech | Direct: ahad@almnexus.tech

---

## 1. Organization & Delivery Principles

ALM Nexus is a custom software engineering and AI automation agency focused on shipping measurable software with zero proprietary vendor lock-in. Every client engagement follows a transparent three-stage cycle:
1. Scope and architecture: Data model, user roles, tech stack, and milestone agreement before implementation.
2. Sprint build: Weekly working staging builds deployed directly for live interactive testing.
3. Deploy and handoff: Production deployment to client-owned cloud infrastructure (AWS, Railway, Oracle Cloud VM, Vercel, Apple App Store, Google Play) with complete Git repository, environment schemas, and documentation transfer.

---

## 2. Supported Technology Matrix

- **Mobile Engineering:** Flutter (Dart), React Native (TypeScript), Expo Cross-Platform (OTA updates), Native iOS (SwiftUI), Native Android (Kotlin), APNs/FCM push notifications, Stripe & in-app subscriptions, WebSocket real-time chat.
- **Web & SaaS Engineering:** Next.js, React, TypeScript, Vite, Tailwind CSS, Node.js, Express SSR, Python FastAPI, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, multi-tenant row/organization isolation, Role-Based Access Control (RBAC), Stripe billing, Resend & SMTP transactional infrastructure.
- **AI Agents & Automation:** Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) with source citations, pgvector, Qdrant, OpenAI/Anthropic/Gemini APIs, Private Self-Hosted Open-Weight LLMs (vLLM, Ollama inside dedicated VPC), Hybrid PII-redaction pipelines, n8n webhook orchestrations, CRM triage & sync (HubSpot, Pipedrive, NexusFlow).
- **Data Engineering & Web Scraping:** Python FastAPI async workers, HTTPX/BeautifulSoup fast parsing, Playwright headless Chromium dynamic JavaScript/SPA rendering, entity resolution & deduplication, DNS MX & live SMTP mailbox verification, CSV/JSON/PDF/REST/PostgreSQL delivery.
- **Cybersecurity & Auditing:** Manual Grey-Box Web & API Penetration Testing, Black-Box External Attack Surface Testing, OWASP Top 10 & API Security Top 10 (BOLA/IDOR, JWT tampering, RBAC bypass, SSRF, XSS, SQLi), Source Code Reviews (SAST), Cloud & Linux Server Hardening (SSH, IAM, VPC, Nginx TLS), CVSS v3.1 reporting + free 30-day remediation re-testing.
- **Game Prototyping:** Unity 2D/3D, C#, custom rigidbody/physics systems, deterministic state machines.

## 3. Core Service Blueprints & Configurators

### 3.1 Custom Mobile App Development (iOS & Android)
- Canonical URL: https://almnexus.tech/services/app-development
- Who It Is For: Startups, consumer brands, fintech wallets, and field/logistics teams launching cross-platform or hardware-integrated mobile apps.
- Comparison Paths:
  - Flutter (Dart): Single codebase, GPU-rendered 60/120fps pixel-identical UI, 2–4 week MVP.
  - React Native & Expo: Fastest TypeScript launch sharing logic with React web apps, instant OTA updates, 2–3 week MVP.
  - Native iOS (SwiftUI): Hardware-critical Apple performance, HealthKit/AR/Metal, smallest binary.
  - Native Android (Kotlin): Enterprise POS, NFC scanners, reliable background GPS tracking, 3–5 week build.
- Interactive Configurator Options: UI templates (SaaS Mobile Dashboard, E-Commerce & Delivery, On-Demand Booking, Fintech & Wallet UI) + backend modules (Node.js/FastAPI API, PostgreSQL/Supabase/Firebase, Push Notifications, Stripe Payments, Real-Time Chat).

### 3.2 Custom Web & SaaS Platform Development
- Canonical URL: https://almnexus.tech/services/web-development
- Who It Is For: SaaS founders, agencies, and B2B operations teams replacing spreadsheets or building subscription software.
- Architecture Paths:
  - Marketing & SEO Websites (1–2 weeks): Prerendered static/SSR pages engineered for Google Core Web Vitals and structured Schema.org indexing.
  - Single-Page Web Apps (2–3 weeks MVP): Responsive calculators, analytical tables, and interactive browser utilities.
  - Multi-Tenant B2B SaaS (3–6 weeks MVP): Strict tenant key enforcement, Stripe subscription billing, and team RBAC.
  - Internal CRM & Ops Portals (2–4 weeks): Zero per-seat licensing fees with tailored pipeline stages and webhooks.
- Stack Options: Next.js/React+TS, React+Vite+Tailwind, Express SSR+React; UI templates (Multi-Tenant SaaS, Agency Product Site, Internal CRM Pipeline, E-Commerce Storefront); Backends (Node.js Express, Python FastAPI, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, RBAC).

### 3.3 AI Agents, RAG & Workflow Automation
- Canonical URL: https://almnexus.tech/services/ai-automation
- Who It Is For: Customer support desks, B2B sales teams, and regulated healthcare/legal firms automating high-volume knowledge and routing tasks.
- Solutions:
  - RAG Knowledge Assistants (1–2 weeks): Strict citation grounding over PDFs, SOPs, and SQL databases with zero-hallucination escalation rules.
  - B2B Lead & Scraping Agents (1–3 weeks): Autonomous crawlers scoring ICP fit and enriching CRM records.
  - n8n & API Automations (1–2 weeks): Cross-app event triggers across email, WhatsApp, CRM, and billing without per-task SaaS markups.
  - Private Self-Hosted LLMs (1–3 weeks): Air-gapped open-weight models running on client VPC/GPU hardware via vLLM or Ollama, plus Hybrid PII-Redacted routing.

### 3.4 B2B Lead Generation & Web Data Engineering
- Canonical URL: https://almnexus.tech/services/data-intelligence
- Who It Is For: Outbound SDR teams, research analysts, and SaaS platforms needing clean, bounce-checked datasets or automated delta feeds.
- 4-Stage Pipeline:
  1. Hybrid Crawling: Async HTTP + Playwright headless Chromium for SPAs, directories, catalogs, and infinite scroll (48–72 hours for datasets).
  2. Clean & Deduplicate: Entity resolution, normalized phone/company/domain schemas ready for instant CRM upload.
  3. Live DNS MX / SMTP Verification: Mailbox handshake validation eliminating dead addresses to protect outbound sender reputation.
  4. Flexible Delivery: Clean UTF-8 CSV/JSON exports, live REST API & PostgreSQL tables, or scheduled Google Sheets / HubSpot / CRM sync.

### 3.5 Web App Penetration Testing & Security Audits
- Canonical URL: https://almnexus.tech/services/cybersecurity
- Who It Is For: Pre-launch SaaS platforms, fintech startups, and teams preparing for enterprise buyer security due diligence.
- Methodologies:
  - Grey-Box Penetration Testing (5–10 business days): Authenticated multi-role testing uncovering RBAC bypasses, BOLA/IDOR flaws, and tenant isolation gaps.
  - Black-Box & OWASP Top 10 Testing (5–7 business days): External attacker simulation targeting public auth, APIs, XSS, SQLi, and SSRF with zero false-positive scanner spam.
  - Source Code Audit / SAST (3–7 business days): Manual line-by-line inspection of auth middleware, database queries, secret handling, and dependencies.
  - Cloud & Server Hardening (2–5 business days): AWS, Oracle VM, Railway, SSH, IAM, VPC, and Nginx TLS header lockdown.
- Deliverables: Executive Risk Summary (CVSS), Reproducible Proof-of-Concept HTTP payloads, Developer Patch Guide, and a Free 30-Day Remediation Re-Test attestation (under Mutual NDA & RoE).

## 4. Free Public Tool: AI Web Scraper & Lead Extractor

- Canonical URL: https://almnexus.tech/tools/web-data-engine
- Pricing: Free (no account required; supports up to 20 crawled pages and 25 deep profile visits per job)
- Engine Architecture: Python FastAPI backend (`GET /health`, `POST /api/v1/inspect`, `POST /api/v1/crawl`, `GET /api/v1/jobs/{job_id}`) using hybrid fast HTTP parsing and automatic Playwright headless Chromium escalation.
- Extractable Data Categories: Business Emails, Personal Emails, Phone Numbers, WhatsApp Links (`wa.me`), Social Profiles (LinkedIn, X, Instagram, Facebook, YouTube, TikTok), Page Metadata & Contacts, Images, Nested Directory/Store Profiles, Quotes, and Book Catalogs.
- Export Formats: CSV spreadsheet, clean JSON, and formatted PDF summary report.
